digest.component_or_area: LLM code review workflow — concurrency overlay registration
propositions: The concurrency overlay must be added to OVERLAY_IDS enum and wired through overlay_id_enum() to enable base reviewer escalation.

Content-triggered detection must scan both added and removed diff lines for a committed high-precision token tuple (Mutex, Lock, Semaphore, pthread_, go func, tokio::spawn, etc.) to fire the concurrency overlay.
Routing configuration must set concurrency overlay to advisory posture with 0.95 threshold and blocking disabled.
Gate dispatch must explicitly wire the code-review-concurrency prompt in both round_a and round_b batches gated on include_concurrency outputs.
Negative controls: async/await-only diffs, tokens on context lines only, and excluded noisy tokens (bare fork, .lock, Promise.all, etc.) must NOT fire the concurrency overlay.
